column3: Rebase #94's dithered charts on dither-kit's canvas engine (Bayer 4x4, density as alpha, gradient/dotted/hatched/solid variants, bloom, gradient wash) instead of #94's SVG Bayer-8 dot patterns; one framework-free module, plugins/visual/frame/dither.ts, for charts, Appearance and cards
column4: Bosun relayed Keyur: use dither-kit as the base. Its engine varies alpha rather than shade, so one colour reads on both themes; #94's stepped SVG patterns could not fade smoothly or glow. dither-kit declares MIT only in package.json (no LICENSE file), so LICENSE-dither-kit carries the standard text with that note
column5: web/e2e/visual.test.ts: bars denser at base than tip, bloom layer present, wash dissolves; renders dark and light
column6: pass; the Appearance dither (XIN-27) still uses its own 8x8 halftone until it adopts the module
